thread:
Evan Brooks: Falcon Systems sent a security review packet. Main asks: RBAC change audit for tenant-scoped service accounts, proof of tenant key rotations + KMS envelope metadata, and confirmation of our retention/redaction rules. They also want an example of vuln triage where a CVE impacted a model runtime and how we handled it.

Priya Nair: Thanks. Is Falcon Dedicated or hosted? That changes what KMS artifacts we can provide.

Hannah Cho: They're hosted (multi-tenant) but will request Dedicated if the answers don't satisfy them. We need to be clear about what hosted tenants can get vs. Dedicated (HSM attestations).

Ravi Singh: For RBAC: we can export the change-log for service_account resources from our platform-iam store. I can produce a CSV with columns: timestamp, operator, resource_id, old_roles, new_roles, approval_ticket_id.

Evan Brooks: Good. Please include a short note about ephemeral autoscaler SAs that rotate frequently and point to the autoscaler audit index.

Li Wei: KMS: for hosted tenants we can provide envelope metadata and KMS audit events (create_version, disable_version, rotate). We cannot export customer plaintext or unwrapped keys. Also we can provide the signed KMS service logs that show key version lifecycle. Example entry we can include in the bundle (sanitized): {"timestamp":"2026-01-15T03:12:05Z","event":"CreateKeyVersion","key_id":"rk_abc123","version":"v2","actor":"kms-service"} — I will sanitize IDs.

Hannah Cho: Falcon asked for a "signed rotation timeline". We usually provide a timeline.md + sha256 manifest of the KMS audit slice and our signed export key signed by our evidence signing key. Ops: can you generate the signed bundle?

Ravi Singh: Yes. Command I'll run:

```
redwoodctl evidence create --tenant falcon --slice kms --from 2025-12-01 --to 2026-01-15 --signed --out falcon_kms_timeline_20260115.tar.gz
```

Evan Brooks: For vuln triage example: they want a concrete incident where a model runtime had a vuln (e.g., dependency CVE) and we applied mitigations. We should not include internal PII or host-level forensic snapshots in the bundle. Instead provide an anonymized timeline: detection, impact assessment, rollout of a patched runtime, canary validation, and postmortem.

Priya Nair: Do we have a public-friendly writeup? Maybe the 2025-07 runtime CVE (was it CVE-2025-3344?) — we can include a redacted postmortem showing times and actions, and attach the patch PR IDs.

Hannah Cho: I'll draft the redacted postmortem. Key points to cover: signal source (OSS vuln scanner + model ops telemetry), affected clusters, mitigation steps (hotfix container, rollback risk analysis), verification steps (canary logs + smoke tests), and follow-up hardening (dependency pinning + CI gating).

Li Wei: Regarding SIEM/forwarding proof, we can include delivery receipts and last-hop HTTP receipts to customer SIEM endpoints. Example receipt (sanitized): {"tenant":"falcon","seq":559912,"delivered_at":"2026-01-12T22:11:09Z","signature":"sha256:..."}. We'll include a short README explaining retention windows.

Evan Brooks: Falcon is also asking about audit log immutability. We should include our append-only log description and the signed manifest/checksum approach we use for evidence exports.

Ravi Singh: Action items:
- Ravi: export IAM change CSV for service accounts + note on autoscaler SAs (due Tue EOD)
- Li: KMS audit slice + sanitized timeline + signed bundle (due Tue EOD)
- Hannah: redacted vuln postmortem + patch PR references (due Mon)
- Priya: draft call notes + high-level statement about retained telemetry/no plaintext (due Mon)

Priya Nair: We should also prepare a short slide (2-3 bullets) on limitations: no plaintext, no private HSM vendor certs without customer NDA/ops window, and autoscaler ephemeral creds nuance.

sec-bot: Reminder: place final artifacts in /evidence-requests/falcon/ and set ACL to falcon-security@falcon.com. Evidence retention policy: artifacts stored for 90 days unless customer requests deletion.

Hannah Cho: Q on legal: do we need a datasharing addendum for signed manifests? I think it's fine but loop in Legal if they request vendor certs.

Priya Nair: I'll loop Legal for any ambiguous pieces. For now proceed with sanitized exports.

Evan Brooks: Scheduling: Falcon asked for a 30m sync. I'm available Wed 10am PT or Thu 2pm PT. Which is best?

Ravi Singh: Wed 10am PT works. Evan please send calendar invite and include the 1-page limitation slide.

Evan Brooks: Will do. I'll attach the draft timeline and call agenda. Ping here when artifacts land in /evidence-requests/falcon/.

Li Wei: Uploading KMS bundle now -> will post link when complete.

Hannah Cho: Postmortem draft coming shortly.

Priya Nair: Thanks everyone. Keep the thread updated with uploads and any legal flags.
